mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Vorpal Spikes</titleLeft><mainText>Cho'gath's attacks summon spikes to impale enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Cho'Gath's attacks passively release deadly spikes, dealing damage to all enemy units in front of him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Cho'gath's attacks launch spikes that deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Vorpal Spike's width increases with Cho'gath's size.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers health and mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Killing an enemy restores <healing>@Jade_ChogathCarnivoreHeal@ Health</healing> and <scaleMana>@Jade_ChogathCarnivoreMana@ Mana</scaleMana>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Rupture</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is flying through the air and can take no actions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies for @KnockUpDuration@ second, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowAmountPercentage@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Rupture</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is flying through the air and can take no actions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Feast</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has grown larger, gaining @f1@ bonus health.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum health (maximum 6 stacks). Cho'Gath loses half of his stacks upon death.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing <trueDamage>@RDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> to champions or <trueDamage>@RMonsterDamage@</trueDamage> to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain <healing>@RHealthPerStack@ max Health</healing> (maximum 6 stacks). Loses half of his stacks on death.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Cho'Gath roars, <status>Silencing</status> enemies for @SilenceDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
